question: Should OpenClaw accept this staged signed marketplace feed config before signed refresh enforcement merges?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it exposes new marketplace supply-chain trust configuration and a deliberate fail-closed runtime path; that is a security-boundary/product choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept staged config slice

options.title: Land with refresh enforcement
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 or equivalent enforcement is ready so accepted signed config has an immediate runtime consumer.

options.title: Pause the trust stack
options.body: Keep the stack open but unmerged if the signed marketplace feed direction is not ready to become an OpenClaw contract.
